version.description: Format version. Bump rules follow docs/03: additive fields are always ok.

subject.description: What was measured: a model id, or a classifier name.

metrics.description: Suite-specific numbers, sorted so two runs of the same suite diff cleanly.

failures_omitted.description: Failures beyond `MAX_FAILURES`. Present so a short list is never mistaken for a short tail.

provenance.description: What produced this, so a number can be traced back to a build (docs/19 §gates).

detail.description:
What went wrong, in one line. Never the model's full output — a scorecard is an artifact
people commit, and a transcript in it is a content-retention decision nobody made.

commit.description: Git commit of the tree that produced this.

quantization.description:
The quantization the subject was measured at.

docs/19 §gates: "quantize → then eval; quality dies at the quant step, so that's where you
measure". A scorecard that does not say which quantization it measured is a number that
cannot be compared to the artifact anyone actually runs.
